text: Why do we offer sacrifices to our ancestors in our family shrine? Because we ought not to forget them. Why must we cultivate our minds and be circumspect in our actions? Because we do not wish to bring disgrace upon the name of our ancestors.
author: Confucius and Zengzi
reference: The Classic of Filial Piety (Xiao Jing)
locator: Chapter XVI, The Influence and Fruit of Filial Piety
